description: Get All Ledgers. Part of the Ledgers APIs in Giddh. Requires Auth-Key or Session-Id.

count.description: Page size (number of items returned). Default: 50.

sort.description: Sort direction. Allowed values: asc, desc. Default: desc.

sortBy.description: Field name to sort by. Default: date.

voucherType.description: Voucher type for recurring or list APIs.

branchUniqueName.description: Branch uniqueName; omit for default company branch behaviour.

raw.value:
{
  "accountUniqueName": "string",
  "particularUniqueName": "string",
  "description": "string",
  "entryTotal": 0,
  "totalIsEqual": false,
  "totalIsLess": false,
  "totalIsMore": false,
  "entryDate": "string",
  "dateIsEqual": false,
  "dateIsBefore": false,
  "dateIsAfter": false
}

totalIsEqual.description: When true, applies the total is equal filter or flag.

totalIsLess.description: When true, applies the total is less filter or flag.

totalIsMore.description: When true, applies the total is more filter or flag.

dateIsEqual.description: When true, applies the date is equal filter or flag.

dateIsBefore.description: When true, applies the date is before filter or flag.

dateIsAfter.description: When true, applies the date is after filter or flag.
